# Getting help

Thanks for using **Lunora**! Here is where to go depending on what you need.

## Questions & usage help

- 📚 **Documentation** — start at [lunora.sh](https://lunora.sh). Most "how do I…" answers live here.
- 💬 **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/anolilab/lunora/discussions)** — for questions, ideas, "is this a bug?", and showing what you built. This is the best place for open-ended help.

Please **do not** open an Issue to ask a question — questions are routed to Discussions so the tracker stays focused on actionable work.

## Bugs & feature requests

- 🐛 **Bug?** Open a [bug report](https://github.com/anolilab/lunora/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). Include a minimal reproduction, your environment, and what you expected.
- ✨ **Feature idea?** Open a [feature request](https://github.com/anolilab/lunora/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml), or float it in Discussions first if it is still half-baked.

Before filing, please [search existing issues](https://github.com/anolilab/lunora/issues?q=is%3Aissue) — a quick search often finds an existing thread.

## Security

Please **do not** report security vulnerabilities through public issues, discussions, or pull requests. Follow the process in [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md).

## Contributing

Want to fix it yourself? See [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for local setup, the commit convention, and the PR checklist.

## Commercial / sensitive matters

For anything sensitive or private, email **d.bannert@anolilab.de**.

## Supporting the project

Lunora is free and open source. If it helps you, consider sponsoring via [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/prisis) — it directly funds continued development.
